parts.html: When a professional designer takes on the task, even a small balcony can be transformed into a cozy and functional space for relaxation and entertainment all year round. In our case — it’s 8 square meters of pure relaxation.
The balcony begins with a spacious, comfortable corner sofa placed along the walls. Soft pillows and throws add a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

Along the balcony’s glazed edge, there’s a sleek bar counter with high stools — perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails with a city view. It’s made from natural materials like wood and metal, seamlessly blending with the overall design.

A built-in-looking storage cabinet is cleverly integrated into the wall (a visual trick), offering plenty of space for seasonal items, pillows, blankets, tools, and more. Its modern, minimalist design keeps the space clean and uncluttered.
A compact yet fully functional BBQ area is included. The grill is placed on its own stand to ensure safety and ease of use.
To make the balcony usable year-round, a UFO heater provides warmth and comfort even during cold months — ideal for family evenings and cozy gatherings with friends.
Potted plants and climbing greenery bring a refreshing, natural feel. Floor and built-in lighting create a romantic evening ambiance and highlight the details.
This balcony becomes a true gem of the apartment — a stylish, comfortable, and fully usable space designed for year-round enjoyment thanks to thoughtful planning and modern solutions.
